title: Returned Remittances Counted toward the Rural Home Loans Returned-Payment Fee — Decision Table
content:
On Rural Home Loans, the other returned remittances counted toward the returned-payment fee are chosen by how the returned remittance was made and, for an automatic debit, by how the member's Farm Real Estate Loans loan is paid.

## Rule

The other returned remittances counted toward the fee are chosen as follows, the returned remittance being an automatic debit or a one-time payment as the channel on its return entries shows: for an automatic debit, when the member's farm real estate loan is also paid by automatic debit, the remittances returned in the twelve months up to today on the farm real estate loan count together with the other remittances returned on the home loan in those months, because both debits draw on the household's account; for a one-time payment by phone, online banking or the mobile app, only the other one-time payments returned on the home loan in the twelve months up to today count, a returned automatic debit not counting, because a failed one-time payment repeats the member's own instruction; otherwise the other remittances returned on the home loan in the twelve months up to today count.

## Definitions

- **The returned remittance:** the remittance the fee is being figured for; "other" remittances exclude it.
- **Channel:** the channel shown on the remittance's return entries — automatic debit, phone, online banking or mobile app.
- **Farm loan paid by automatic debit:** the member's farm real estate loan in active status shows automatic debit enrolled on its record.
- **Returned in the twelve months up to today:** a principal payment return entry dated from the day after the same calendar day twelve months before today through today, on the home loan or, where it counts, on the Farm Real Estate Loans loan.

## Decision table

| Channel of the returned remittance | Farm loan paid by automatic debit | Remittances counted |
|---|---|---|
| automatic debit | yes | other home-loan returns in the twelve months plus farm-loan returns in the twelve months |
| automatic debit | no | other home-loan returns in the twelve months |
| phone, online banking or mobile app | either | other one-time home-loan returns (phone, online banking, mobile app) in the twelve months |
| any other channel | either | other home-loan returns in the twelve months |

## Worked count (hypothetical ledger)

The home loan shows, in the twelve months, the remittance now returned (an automatic debit), one earlier returned automatic debit and one returned online-banking payment; the farm loan, paid by automatic debit, shows one returned remittance. Counted: two other home-loan returns plus one farm-loan return, three in all. Had the remittance now returned been a mobile-app payment, only the online-banking return would count: one.
